source_review: GetDurationUnitOptions returns Just(DurationUnitOptions({style, display})) only after both option lookups initialize their outputs. Every exceptional path returns Nothing<DurationUnitOptions>.
The actual V8 Maybe<T>::To assigns the complete value before returning true; it returns false without assigning when the Maybe is empty.
MAYBE_ASSIGN_RETURN_ON_EXCEPTION_VALUE returns from the constructor when To returns false. Thus every path reaching years_option.style or either display setter has initialized that complete record.
The month lookup occurs after the successful year assignment. If either year or month style/display getter fails, constructor exit precedes subsequent lookups and every affected field read.
interpretation: The full-build warnings conservatively lose the correlation between the Maybe success state and complete output assignment. This conclusion is supported by the unchanged source and passing controls; it is not a claim to have minimized the GCC full-build reproducer.

coverage.cpp_modes: 288400 cases each in release and DEBUG configurations, normally and under Valgrind.
coverage.cases: All four base styles, unset/long/short/narrow years and months, unset/auto/always displays, failure at each of the four lookups, and invalid values in each field. Early failure must leave the caller output untouched and perform no later lookups.
coverage.memory: Both Valgrind runs report zero errors and free every allocation, without suppressions.
coverage.actual_node: 11536 actual Intl.DurationFormat cases against packaged Node 24.18.1: option results, exact exception propagation and getter order, nonempty formatting, and formatToParts reconstruction.

limits: The complete helper, enum declarations and assignment macros are source extracts; the enclosing macro return type is adapted to the standalone result.
The actual upstream v8-maybe.h is included. Typed option lookup and Isolate adapters replace object handles and exception plumbing; actual JavaScript controls separately exercise that plumbing.
The native control covers the years/months fields named by the diagnostics, not the numeric/fractional hour-to-nanosecond paths.
Smaller controls compile without reproducing the three full-build warnings. The exact full-build sites remain visible and require explicit acceptance.

Initial control compilation enabled extra unused-parameter diagnostics in public no-op headers. The final control uses V8's existing -Wno-unused-parameter policy from the actual compiler receipt; no package or runtime flags change.
The complete updated RPM and native ARM qualification remain separate gates.
